label: NORMAL
rationale: AVGO qualifies as a Core Outlier on business quality: AI custom compute/networking demand is structurally expanding, moat breadth is increasing, and cash conversion is exceptional. The Sep. 3 price embeds strong but not implausibly bullish FCF growth. The main unresolved gating risk is customer/design-win concentration, so a NORMAL rather than HIGH_CONVICTION band is appropriate until customer diversification and FY2027-2028 execution are further evidenced.
increase_evidence: AI semiconductor revenue tracks or exceeds the FY2027 trajectory without gross-margin deterioration.
Additional hyperscaler/frontier-model customers reach material production scale, reducing single-customer dependence.
Ethernet networking share and attach rate rise alongside custom-accelerator deployments.
FCF/share grows faster than revenue after accounting for SBC and net dilution.
VMware retention and VCF adoption remain strong despite licensing changes.
reduce_or_exit_evidence: Loss or material downsizing of a top custom-accelerator design win.
AI revenue growth decelerates well below capacity commitments while inventories/receivables build.
Persistent net share dilution despite large repurchases.
VMware customer attrition produces structural software revenue or margin decline.
Valuation re-rates to a level requiring the full bull case while evidence does not improve.
